name: What to Expect During a Professional Flooring Installation Project

step.name: Step 1: Initial Consultation and Measurement
step.text: This is where we discuss your vision, help you choose the right flooring material – whether it's durable hardwood, engineered options, or waterproof vinyl – and accurately measure the area. This ensures we order the correct amount of material and plan for any specific installation challenges.

step.name: Step 2: Substrate Inspection and Preparation
step.text: Before any new flooring goes down, we'll thoroughly inspect your subfloor. This involves checking for damage, moisture, and unevenness. We'll then clean, level, and repair the subfloor as needed, creating a perfect base for your new floor. This step is critical for a smooth and durable installation.

step.name: Step 3: Product Acclimation (if required)
step.text: For certain materials, especially wood and some laminates, the flooring needs to acclimate to your home's environment for at least 48 hours. This helps prevent warping or gapping later. We'll make sure this crucial step isn't skipped, controlling temperature and humidity as necessary.

step.name: Step 4: Installation of Underlayment and Flooring
step.text: Once everything is prepped and acclimated, we'll install any necessary underlayment, followed by the flooring itself. Our skilled installers will meticulously lay each piece, ensuring proper alignment, secure fastening, and adherence to manufacturer guidelines.

step.name: Step 5: Finishing Touches and Cleanup
step.text: After the main installation, we’ll handle all the finishing details like installing transitions between rooms, new baseboards, or trim. We then conduct a thorough cleanup, removing all debris and leaving your space pristine and ready for you to enjoy your beautiful new floor.
